description: Two player reports, one overlay. (a) v1.17.2: dragging a model to the edge of the green dashed ring left part of a wide base poking outside the dashes, because the ring marked where the model's CENTRE could stop. That was fixed by inflating the ring by Measurement.base_extent_px. (b) The Battlewagon report that undid it: the inflated ring then advertised move the drag would refuse — 4.05" of it on a 100x180mm rectangular base — because _clamp_move_to_budget stops the model's CENTRE at the remaining budget, and 11e measures a move "from the same point on its base at the start and end of that move" with rotation free, i.e. a plain centre-to-centre translation. The overlay now answers both with two distinct marks: the bright DASHED RING at exactly the remaining move (the boundary the drag honours), and a faint continuous HULL HALO one base extent further out (how far the hull itself can end up, worst case over every facing the free pivot allows). Driven live on U_TELEMON_HEAVY_DREADNOUGHT_I (100mm base, M8), repositioned onto verified open ground at (1280,1310) — a corridor probed live against TerrainManager: calculate_movement_terrain_penalty((1280,1310)->(1600,1310)) == 0.0 and model_overlaps_any_wall / model_outside_board are false at both ends. Real player path: click the token to begin the Normal Move, then a real mouse drag PAUSED mid-flight (release:false) exactly 8" to the right, so the live frame can be inspected while the model sits at max range. Asserts: (1) the base extent is a visually significant ~79px; (2) the dashed ring radius equals the move cap in px EXACTLY, with no base extent added; (3) the drag really travelled the full 8", the move is still legal, and the model's CENTRE sits ON the dashed ring — the ring is the drag limit, not a suggestion; (4) a MoveHullReach halo is drawn one base extent further out, so the furthest point of the base sits on IT rather than in empty space (report (a) still covered); (5) the halo is drawn far fainter and thinner than the ring, so it cannot be mistaken for the drag boundary; (6) the label still reports the movement distance (8"), not a radius.

steps.script:
# Frame the whole ring: world (1440,1310) — the midpoint of the drag — at
# screen centre, zoom 1.2. Ring radius is ~399 board px -> ~479 screen px,
# so the whole ring clears 1920x1080.
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 1.2
m.view_offset = Vector2(1440.0, 1310.0) - Vector2(960.0, 540.0) / 1.2
m.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: 8 dash arcs + the distance label + the MoveHullReach halo

steps.script:
# The paused drag really is at max range (8").
var mc = tree.root.get_node("Main").movement_controller
var moved: float = mc.current_path[1].distance_to(mc.drag_start_pos) / Measurement.PX_PER_INCH
return abs(moved - mc.move_cap_inches)
